title: Search or frisking
officerCan: Search where the law authorises it, following the prescribed procedure.
Seize items, provided the seizure is recorded and a copy of the list is given to you.
officerCannot: Search a female person other than by a female officer, and otherwise than with strict regard to decency.
Seize items without recording the seizure and giving you a copy.

quotableLine.en: I am not objecting to a lawful search. Please record whatever is taken and give me a copy of the list.
quotableLine.hi: मैं वैध तलाशी का विरोध नहीं कर रहा। कृपया जो भी लिया जाए उसे दर्ज कीजिए और मुझे सूची की कॉपी दीजिए।
quotableLine.ta: சட்டப்படியான சோதனைக்கு நான் மறுப்பு தெரிவிக்கவில்லை. எடுக்கப்படுவதைப் பதிவு செய்து, பட்டியலின் நகலைத் தாருங்கள்.
quotableLine.te: చట్టబద్ధమైన సోదనకు నేను అభ్యంతరం చెప్పడం లేదు. తీసుకున్నదాన్ని నమోదు చేసి, జాబితా కాపీ ఇవ్వండి.
quotableLine.bn: আইনসম্মত তল্লাশিতে আমার আপত্তি নেই। যা নেওয়া হচ্ছে তা লিখে রাখুন এবং তালিকার কপি দিন।
quotableLine.mr: कायदेशीर झडतीला माझी हरकत नाही. जे घेतले जाईल त्याची नोंद करा आणि यादीची प्रत द्या.
quotableLine.kn: ಕಾನೂನುಬದ್ಧ ಶೋಧನೆಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಆಕ್ಷೇಪವಿಲ್ಲ. ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡದ್ದನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೊಡಿ.

doNotSay: Any physical blocking of the search.
documentNow: Who conducted the search, whether a female officer was present, and every item taken.

options.label: If you are a woman, ask for a female officer before the search begins.
options.rationale: The requirement applies at the start; raising it afterwards is far weaker.

options.label: Ask for the seizure list and a copy of it.
options.rationale: Without the memo there is no record of what was taken.

options.label: Ask that a bystander witness the search.
options.rationale: Independent witnesses are what make the record hold up.

verification.notes: Placeholder from PRD table. Not checked against bare act. Needs advocate sign-off for legal accuracy AND for escalation risk (PRD R3).
